source_text: Salomon interpretatur pacificus. Pacificus vero Christus est, qui fecit utraque unum. Merito ergo pacificus scribit Canticum pacis et caritatis, in quo sponsus et sponsa in unum foedus conveniunt. Ubi Christus pax nostra habitat, ibi vere Canticum Canticorum canitur.
pass_a_gloss: Solomon is-interpreted peaceful. Peaceful however Christ is who made both one. Rightly therefore peaceful writes Song of-peace and charity...
pass_b_english: Solomon is interpreted peaceful. But the Peaceful One is Christ, who [[made both one >> Bible:Ephesians 2:14]]. Rightly, then, the Peaceful One writes the Song of peace and charity, in which Bridegroom and Bride meet in one covenant. Where Christ our peace dwells, there the Song of Songs is truly sung.
